title: Fast Sleep

body:
**FastSleep** — is a Minecraft modification that turns the boring night-skipping process into a dynamic experience. Instead of an instant teleportation to morning, the mod speeds up time, allowing crops to grow and mobs to move faster right before your eyes.

# Main Features:
- Dynamic Time Warp: Time in the world begins to fly faster as soon as you go to bed. You can see the moon setting and the sun rising in real-time.
 
- Local Acceleration: While you sleep, the mod "boosts" game ticks within a specified radius around the player. This means your crops grow and mobs perform more actions while the world is accelerated.

- Full In-Game Configuration: Forget about endlessly editing config files. Manage all mod parameters using the /fs command.
 
- Bilingual Interface: Support for Russian and English languages with instant switching.

# Control Commands
All mod management is handled via the /fs command.
- /fs Opens the help menu and a list of available parameters.
- /fs speed <number> Sets the time warp speed (1-1000).
- /fs radius <number> Sets the acceleration radius for crops/mobs (1-100 blocks).
- /fs mobs <true/false> Enables or disables mob acceleration within the radius.
- /fs crops <true/false> Enables or disables crop growth acceleration within the radius.
- /fs machines <true/false> Enables or disables machines acceleration within the radius.
- /fs lang <ru/en> Switches the language for mod commands and responses.
